title: Influence of annealing on mechanical and electrochemical properties of cold sprayed niobium coatings

preSprayedProperties.Overall_Powder_Name: Commercially available fused and crushed niobium powder

experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: to heat treatment in vacuum furnace (10−6 mbar) 750 C for 2 h and allowed to furnace cool. Initially, all the coatings were heat treated at a chamber pressure of 10−4 mbar. These coatings failed in a brittle manner during the microtensile tests. Since these coatings failed in a brittle manner, all the coatings have been heat treated again in 10−6 mbar chamber pressure
